prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE DESIGN COMP for a Traditional Chinese LINE Bot development record. Render the webpage edge to edge, landscape 1440x1000 proportions, no browser or device chrome, no desk, no poster, no photo of a document. It must look like a real readable development-record website with actual navigation and selectable-looking text. Teacher audience, READ mode: stable document navigation, calm 65-75 character reading columns, real body text at comfortable ~16-18px, clear hierarchy, all four required sections easy to find. This is a new whole-page design direction, not the prior green comparison page. No generic hero metrics dashboard, no invented accomplishments, no fake LINE screenshot, no unrequested AI-chat feature. Actual project name exactly "待辦小幫手". Actual document title "LINE Bot 改善紀錄". Actual opening "新增查詢功能，讓記錄的待辦可以回看。" Four genuine section headings: "原本的問題", "修改內容", "前後差異", "重新測試結果". Also native links "使用說明", "第一版封存". Real facts rendered visibly: "14 組本機測試通過" and "LINE 真人測試待完成". Only version number allowed "0.2.0"; only date allowed "2026-10-05"; no additional dates, no invented identifiers. Opening content: first version could save but not query; improvement adds query for only sender's own latest 10 entries. Actual hard content is a before/after reply comparison for input "查詢": old response "使用方式：記錄：待辦事項"; new response "你的待辦事項（共 1 筆，顯示最新 1 筆）：" then "1. 星期五交報告". Actual test table includes rows for "記錄：星期五交報告" (saved confirmation), "記錄：" (reminder to add content), "你好" (usage help), all LOCAL tests. Show enough lower document content to establish layout beyond title. Core reading column must remain quiet and readable; visual identity belongs in navigation, section frame, margins, comparison/table treatment. No decorative illustration; no fabricated data or underwater facts. Icons only simple consistent UI line icons if earned. Typography Chinese readable Noto Sans TC-like, no decorative monospace Chinese, monospace only small source-code snippets.
Visual world: academic lab protocol interpreted as a precise reading document. Deep navy #16324F chapter rail, teal #17A2B8 active-section markers, white body, pale cyan #E8F4F8 evidence margin. Left vertical navigation 220px, readable primary document ~760px, slim right provenance margin ~230px. Bold but restrained sans headings, a vertical chapter rule aligning the four development stages with actual local evidence links. The margin pairs "本機測試" pass with "LINE 真人" pending in plain words. Comparison uses one clean open paired ruled structure, not floating rounded cards. Focal layout is reading with aligned provenance, not a dashboard. Render whole opening and some test evidence, no lab equipment costume.
